card.name: Word after 'clinical or' and similar
card.fires_on: Mostly the word 'laboratory' in 'clinical or laboratory evidence/findings', and 'clinical' in 'Nonclinical studies'. Also scattered names like Twitter, JPEG and Times.

modes.label: Clinical or laboratory
modes.description: The word 'laboratory' right after 'clinical or' before 'evidence' or 'findings'.
modes.example: avoid use of pioglitazone and metformin hydrochloride tablets in patients with clinical or<< laboratory>> evidence of hepatic disease.

modes.label: Nonclinical studies
modes.description: 'clinical' after 'Non' at the start of an animal-study heading.
modes.example: Non<<clinical>> studies in juvenile rats with lansop

modes.label: Web names
modes.description: Brand or format names in web text such as Twitter, JPEG, Times.
modes.example: Follow @universetoday on<< Twitter>> Were you wondering about the North Star
